title: 전직대통령 예우에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Pensions)
(1) A pension shall be paid to a former President.
(2) The amount of the pension under paragraph (1) shall be an amount equivalent to 95/100 of the annual remuneration of the incumbent President at the time of payment.
